title: Crypto exchange BitMart weighs partial restart and creditor payouts weeks after announcing shutdown
summary: The exchange has hired White & Case as restructuring counsel, with a detailed roadmap expected by Sept. 9.

title: Web3 gaming network Sandbox stops Base and BNB chain bridging after exploit
summary: The Sandbox disabled bridging on affected networks to isolate tokens and warned users not to trade SAND on Base and BNB, citing an impact of under 0.01% of supply.

title: Tokenized stocks risk repeating Wall Street’s 1960s ‘paper crisis,’ Fairmint CEO says
summary: Fairmint CEO Joris Delanoue warns tokenized stocks risk recreating Wall Street’s 1960s paper crisis through fragmented systems and standards.

title: Kalshi off-limits in multiple states as prediction markets, CFTC team up for battle
summary: Washington state is cut off for Kalshi customers while the company combats the development in court and its federal regulator keeps pursuing new rules.

title: Bitcoin and Ether bears get decimated amid 'squeeze-led' rally and Musk's X wants to pay creators in stablecoins: Crypto's week in 5 stories
summary: Bitcoin and crypto staged their strongest rally in months as Treasury intervention, regulatory moves and a historic short squeeze collided, while banks and technology companies pushed deeper into stablecoins.
